target_customer: Importers and SMEs in emerging markets, mainly in Africa, paying overseas suppliers
problem: Importers in emerging markets pay up to 10 percent to settle international invoices and wait weeks for funds to arrive.
business_model: Cross border payments with FX and fee margin, licensed money transmitter

founders.name: Mitch Riley
founders.background_notes: Former COO, CFO and General Counsel at Taptap Send per the YC page.

founders.name: Scott Liddle
founders.background_notes: Former CRO and CMO at Taptap Send per the YC page.

founders.name: Tom (surname not listed)
founders.background_notes: Surname is not given on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs banking and payment rail integrations, compliance tooling and multi jurisdiction licensing, with ordinary software engineering otherwise.

defensibility.rationale: Licenses in Canada, the UK and Cote d'Ivoire plus local banking relationships raise the barrier, though the product is a payments service rather than a unique technology.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established by sources. Capi kept expanding and raised a Series A in 2025.

market_need_then: Capi's launch post says importers paid up to 10 percent in fees and waited weeks, and it booked over 1.5 million dollars in payments in its first two weeks after launching in Senegal.

branding.domain_note: Uses capimoney.com, the name plus the word money.

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened

brand_strength.rationale: A US trademark for the word mark CAPI MONEY was filed in September 2023, but no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Capi launched in Dakar in August 2023 and raised a Series A of about 17.9 million dollars in February 2025 led by Creandum. The founders came from Taptap Send and knew African corridors, and Capi built licenses in several jurisdictions. It is active and scaling.
notes: Series A reported as 17.2M euros, about 17.9M dollars, on 2025-02-18 by several outlets. The company website states a 14.5M dollar Series A in April 2025 as read by the page summarizer, which conflicts and is unverified. Seed in 2023 of about 1.52M dollars appears in one source only and CB Insights shows a convertible note in June 2023 and seed in August 2023, so no seed round is recorded. Finsmes returned 403. No competitor sources dated near 2023 were found, so the list is empty. No education was found for the founders.
